# SLO

**API:** `observability.tsuga.com/v1alpha1` · **Scope:** Namespaced · **Short name:** `tslo`

Manage a native Tsuga SLO with an event- or time-based SLI. Targets must be strictly between 0 and 100; windows are 7, 30, or 90 days. SLI and alert configurations are passed through to Tsuga for validation. Omitting clusterIds selects all clusters; omitting alerts removes alerts. Remote updates recreate alerts with new IDs. See the [SLO guide](../slos/index.md).
